name: Kling 3.0 / 3.0 Turbo / 2.5 Turbo

access.regionNotes: First-party API plus many third-party aggregators. Aggregator rates differ substantially from first-party; Kuaishou is a China-based provider so cross-border access terms vary by reseller.

pricing.unit: per generated second or per clip, depending on reseller
pricing.publicRate: Kling 3.0 720p $0.084-$0.126/s; 3.0 Turbo 720p $0.11/s; 1080p $0.14-$0.168/s. Resellers quote per-clip instead, e.g. $0.35 per 5s 1080p.
pricing.note: Read 2026-09-05 from vendor and reseller pages. Aggregator quotes for the same nominal model ranged from $0.0735/s to $0.35/clip. Do not treat any single figure as the price.

notes: No local run exists in this repository.
Pricing is the least consistent field across this whole database. Kling is resold widely and each reseller re-lists its own number.
